data.narrative:
Blue Water Autonomy is a Series A defense and security autonomy company founded by Rylan Hamilton, Austin Gray, and Scott N. Miller. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 same-sector peers at Series A and Series B stages, consisting of 8 private companies and 2 public equities (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). Top private comparables include Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, Helsing, and Shield AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses the company's $64M total raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression to the next funding stage, yielding an implied valuation of $128M. The peer-median method benchmarks against the 10-company comparable set, which spans a range of $125M to $3.0B, with a median valuation of $1.0B. The peer sample includes Dream Security at $3.0B (Series B), Harmattan AI at $1.4B (Series B), Code Metal at $1.2B (Series B), and Castelion and Defense Unicorns both at $1.0B (Series B).

Triangulating these methods produces a valuation range of $109M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $564M. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage-adjusted valuation multiples in the defense autonomy sector and the heterogeneity of peer growth trajectories. Revenue, margin profile, and customer concentration data would materially narrow this range.
